program.source: export function evaluate({ inputs, time }) { const g = 9.8; const v0 = inputs.launchSpeed; const t = time; const h = v0 * t - 0.5 * g * t * t; const v = v0 - g * t; const height = Math.max(0, h); const laneY = 300; const scale = 40; const ballY = laneY - height * scale; const ballX = 320; const motionState = v > 0.05 ? "Moving up" : (v < -0.05 ? "Moving down" : "Still for an instant"); const gravityState = "Gravity pulls down"; const objects = [sdk.panel({ x: 40, y: 40, w: 560, h: 360, title: "Vertical Toss Motion", state: motionState }), sdk.axis("axis.height", { x: 100, y: 340, length: 260, orientation: "y", min: 0, max: 2.5, label: "Height", unit: "m" }), sdk.groundMark("mark.launch", ballX, 340, 60, "Launch"), sdk.circle("ball.toss", ballX, ballY, 28, { role: "output" }), ...sdk.vector("vec.v", { x: ballX + 20, y: ballY }, { value: Math.abs(v) * (v >= 0 ? 1 : -1), direction: "up" }, { scale: 10, minLength: 12, label: "v" }), ...sdk.vector("vec.a", { x: ballX - 35, y: ballY }, { value: -g, direction: "up" }, { scale: 5, minLength: 12, label: "a" }), sdk.callout(ballX + 45, ballY - 20, [motionState, gravityState], { id: "callout.toss" })]; return { frame: { width: 640, height: 420, objects, readouts: [{ id: "motionState", value: motionState }, { id: "gravityState", value: gravityState }] }, quantities: { launchSpeed: v0, gravity: g, apexTime: v0 / g, apexHeight: (v0 * v0) / (2 * g), velocity: v, height } }; }

manifest.title: The ball stops rising. Gravity doesn’t stop.
manifest.summary: Observe how gravity continues pulling downward even when the ball stops momentarily at the top of its throw.
manifest.description: A ball moves vertically on a height scale. A blue vector indicates its velocity, shortening as it rises and reversing as it falls, while a dashed arrow shows constant downward gravitational acceleration.
assumptions: Gravity fixed at 9.8 m/s^2, no air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed, then press Play. At the top, playback pauses so you can inspect the arrows.
